verdict.rationale: Better Stack's docs say it keeps an incident timeline that feeds automated post-mortems, and that Slack incident events (create, acknowledge, resolve) sync automatically to the dashboard. That covers automatic capture of alerts, actions and Slack activity, but nothing shows the timeline can be edited or annotated afterwards, and its contents are only implied. Missing for 10: documented ability to edit or annotate the timeline, explicit description of what the timeline records (alerts, responder actions, chat decisions), and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an SRE, the incident timeline is captured automatically — alerts, actions, and chat decisions — and I can edit or annotate it afterwards

citations.quote: Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
We automatically sync all events between Slack and the Better Stack dashboard.
